verdict.rationale: The only published pricing is on the firm's Lowenstein x Clerky page. Its FAQ lists fixed prices for one productized startup workflow: $299 for Post-Incorporation Setup on pay-per-use (or included in a Company Lifetime Package) and a $149 managed 83(b) add-on. Beyond that narrow offering, the evidence shows nothing on how legal engagements are priced. Missing for 10: public hourly rate structures, alternative fee arrangements for broader practice areas (venture, M&A, IP, employment), stated billing practices, and independent corroboration of fee transparency.
